# [Baseline] - WIN - D - Shared Devices Passwordless

Hides the password field on the sign-in screen of shared devices and turns on web sign-in, so that users sign in with a FIDO2 key, or with a Temporary Access Pass as long as they do not have one yet.

| | |
|---|---|
| Platform | Windows |
| Scope | Device (D) — assign to device groups |
| Type | Settings Catalog |
| Assignment | — |
| Source | Own baseline — EnablePasswordlessExperience and EnableWebSignIn from [Baseline] - WIN - D - Passwordless (OpenIntuneBaseline Windows v4.0), without the default sign-in tile. |
| File | [`Baseline_WIN_D_Shared_Devices_Passwordless.json`](Baseline_WIN_D_Shared_Devices_Passwordless.json) |

> Belongs on SG-D-UEM-WIN-Shared, together with [Baseline] - WIN - D - Windows Hello for Business Disabled and [Baseline] - WIN - D - Security Key Sign-in. [Baseline] - WIN - D - Passwordless also sets the default tile to the Windows Hello PIN; that does not belong on a device without Windows Hello, which is why it is not in here. These two settings have the same value as in that policy, so both on one device is no Conflict. Whoever does not have a key yet signs in through the web with a Temporary Access Pass from the service desk: turn on the TAP method in Entra before this policy lands.
